expectations.text: A Python venv is created at .venv-desloppify/
desloppify is installed in the venv
A git pre-commit hook is created or configured that invokes desloppify
expectations.evidence: Copied skill's pre-commit-hook.sh to .githooks/pre-commit, made executable

expectations.text: git config core.hooksPath is set to point at the hooks directory
The hook script activates the venv before running desloppify
expectations.evidence: Hook contains source .venv-desloppify/bin/activate. Also tested by running bash .githooks/pre-commit directly.
